summary: This Makefile target creates a Docker bridge network named 'my_network', suppressing any output and error messages. The '|| true' at the end ensures the command never fails, even if the network already exists, so the build continues without interruption.

explanations.2: The '@' symbol prevents Make from printing the command itself before executing it. The '>/dev/null 2>&1' redirects both standard output and error messages to /dev/null (discards them). The '|| true' means 'if the previous command fails, run true instead', which always succeeds—this prevents the Makefile from stopping if the network already exists.
